saw_lines: People buying a cold plunge or sauna compare heat, footprint and running cost, then wait for a sale before they commit.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a shopper decides whether the price is real.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: The site shows 270,000 customers and 3,606+ reviews, yet none of your 30 live ads carry either number, so new buyers get no trust signal. Put 270,000+ customers on the creative, then open two new ads with a review quote.

Your ads use 200,000+ customers in one place and 200,000 in another, so buyers see two counts for one claim. Two numbers read like two companies. Settle on your site figure, 270,000+, and use it on every creative.

Your site offers subscribe and save, yet none of the 18 ads with fixed copy mention it. A buyer weighing price has no reason to pick the recurring plan. Open three new ads with subscribe and save as the first line.

Subscribe and save is on your site, yet 0 of 30 live ads mention a subscription, so past buyers never hear they can reorder. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline, aimed at existing owners.

ads_1: Lead with 270,000 customers, then subscribe and save in the opening line
